mostWorthwhile.text: Reporting the open door as June's observation, then displaying its source and the unavailable sensor, made the limits of the status report concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the finished status page yielded no partners, leaving it unclear what the demonstration still needed.

surprise.text: The disconnected sensor led to an explicit unknown state rather than a false closed reading; a manual observation could then be reported without pretending the sensor worked.

arbitrary.text: The power bank could not be combined until after owner authorization. Authorization had a clear purpose, but why it was a prerequisite for connecting power was not clear to me.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the independent entry test and evidence-labeled status made the infrastructure questions tangible, and I am curious how the local network will be extended.
